features.name: Free spins with bombs
features.description: 4+ lollipop scatters award 10 free spins. Rainbow bomb multipliers (2x–100x) land only during free spins and are added together at the end of each tumble sequence.

features.name: Ante bet
features.description: Raises the stake by 25% to increase scatter frequency.

review:
The candy game that invented pay-anywhere tumbles, years before Gates of Olympus made them everywhere – and it still plays great. Bright and cheerful on the surface, but most real potential lives in the free spins.

Unlike Gates, bomb multipliers don't carry over through the bonus – each tumble sequence stands on its own, which makes individual spins more exciting and the round less predictable. A 21,175x max, way above the original Gates. 96.48% RTP.
pros: High max win for its age
Bombs in every free spin keep the bonus lively
cons: Multipliers do not persist between spins
Base game rarely produces meaningful wins
